_comment: Official warnings. Only entries in this file are ever returned with official_warning=true. Entries with "source": "dmh" are written by risk_engine/dmh_importer.py (DMH, moezala.gov.mm) and are replaced on every import; entries without it are manual and kept as they are. Schema: {id, issuer, type (heavy_rain|cyclone|depression|strong_wind|untimely_rain|flood|tsunami|weather_early_warning|other), regions [canonical names, or "Myanmar" for the whole country], valid_from, valid_to (ISO 8601 with offset), url, links {my,en}, title {my,en}, summary {my,en} (optional), retrieved_at}.
